slots_note: 12 trays x 4 units + the reserve's 16 = 64 stacks of up to 50 bombs (3200 bombs); eight chest rows of eight = 64 slots

frame.size_note: [x, y (up), z] Unity; x includes the bucket hung at the right end (body 2.913 wide)

space.unity: prefab space, origin on the floor at the centre of the footprint, +z front, +y up, +x to the furniture's left seen from the front

groups.rows: two rows of six trays: tier 0 (front) groups 7-12, tier 1 groups 0-5, left to right seen from the front; tier 2 group 6, the raised rear reserve
groups.rule: Homes store: each group's units carry 'item', the bomb kind its tray is for (the reserve has none, only 'example_item'). Group 6 is the reserve (spare) with 16 units. A kind that fills its tray takes an empty one; every layout is packed against all eight bomb shapes, so any kind may lie in any tray without a copy touching another.

band_note: paint mark colour per kind: a worn band on the tray's front board (front wall or riser); the reserve has chalk bands and a faded skull
extra_place: a sand bucket hangs on an iron hook at the right end (seen from the front): no group, no units
fill_order: units are listed compartment by compartment; step 0 is the front-left nest, then left to right, then the back row
position: unit position = the copy's foot: the anchor plane 0.010 over its tray floor (tier floors y [0.185, 0.405, 0.785]); box informational
copy_rule: bombs, no align: independent per-unit rot_quat_xyzw (full 360-degree yaw, bedding-safe 2-14 degree tilt), fit_longest_m 0.22, anchor bottom, offset 0. All unit anchors in a tray share one plane; every kind's measured lowest point stays above the floor and under its own straw (0.066 +- 0.005 over the floor).

layout.one layout: reserve floor 0.785 m overlaps the rear homes in plan; 100 mm bearers clear their tallest bombs. Four independent seeded nest poses per home tray; no repeated layout. The reserve: 16 independently seeded poses, nominally 2 rows of 8, with horizontal jitter and bedding-safe tilt

not_in_game: Dynamite (the mod's Fletcher list names it; the item is BombDynamite)

pose_variation.method: Match logical front-left/front-right/back-left/back-right nests, remove tray translation; position RMS is Euclidean horizontal distance; yaw RMS uses shortest wrapped angle. Reserve windows have their native pitch removed before comparison. Combined = hypot(position_RMS_mm/10, yaw_RMS_deg/30), not a physical unit.

checks.method: mesh against mesh (BVH), including clearance beneath the raised reserve: every copy of every one of the twelve bomb prefabs against the frame without its straw and against every other copy in its tray; the full fill also across trays, the reserve holding each kind in turn, and each kind in all 64 units. Bedding: straw height straight above each copy's lowest point, per kind in every unit.
